research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Canva is researching systems and methods for automatically generating designs, digital designs and editable designs from prompts, often via auto-regressive large language models. Work on image enhancement, image rotation, image processing systems and methods, conditional image generation, prompt-based inpainting and methods for preserving image features during image editing supports advanced visual creation. Additional focus on processing designs and processing of images with text refines layout, typography and document editing. Together these efforts target generative design, intelligent editing and layout automation.
